react_bridge.root_cause: wp-element script loads but wp object not available when bridge runs

widget_initialization_flow: 1. WordPress loads wp-element script (provides wp object)
2. Our bridge script runs and tries to access window.wp
3. Bridge fails because wp object not yet available
4. Widget JavaScript loads but can't initialize without React
5. Container shows static HTML instead of interactive widget

widget_script_analysis.auto_initialization: Script has DOMContentLoaded listener that looks for .heiwa-react-widget-container
widget_script_analysis.react_dependency: Requires window.React and window.ReactDOM to be available

root_cause.primary_issue: Timing problem - React bridge runs before wp-element is fully initialized
secondary_issues: wp object may not be immediately available after wp-element loads
Bridge retry mechanism may not be sufficient for WordPress loading sequence

immediate_fixes.implementation: Use longer initial delay before first bridge attempt
Hook into wp-element script load completion
Use wp_footer action with higher priority

alternative_approaches.implementation: Include React/ReactDOM from external CDN as fallback
alternative_approaches.cons: Additional HTTP requests, potential version conflicts

alternative_approaches.implementation: Include React in the widget build
